redaction: Payloads only. No device address, timestamp-of-day, or link identifier is reproduced; frame times are relative milliseconds from the first frame in each run.
source: User-supplied nRF Connect log, submitter-labelled Schwinn 570u
note: 400 consecutive frames from mid-session of a 10,281-frame ride. Window cadence runs 70-85 rpm and resistance climbs 5 to 11 across the full session.
shortFrameNote: The session's single non-17-byte notification, 05 09 01 01 00. Byte 0 is 5 and the frame is 5 octets, which is V17's length-prefix rule confirmed on a second frame size on the same characteristic. Its octets sum to 0x10, not 0x100, so the checksum rule applies to commands and not to notifications.
